blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Amid negotiations among political parties in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on forming a coalition to form its incoming government, Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF) Vice Chairman Mohagher Iqbal on Saturday said that a final shape up will only emerge when parliament members eventually vote on Oct. 30. Iqbal issued the comment as the Bangsamoro Federalist Party (BFP) announced on Friday that it has secured the support of 46 of 80 elected members of the regional legislature.
